base_dataset_source: Frey & Osborne (2013). The Future of Employment. University of Oxford.

calibration.rationale: Bangladesh national mobile broadband is approximately 70 per 100 but rural penetration is closer to 39 percent (ITU 2024). The garment sector receives above-average international capital investment in robotics and automation, making routine manufacturing tasks face higher-than-average risk relative to other LMIC contexts. Agricultural and rural service work faces lower risk due to infrastructure constraints outside Dhaka and major cities.

scenario_toggles.label: If garment factory robotics investment continues
scenario_toggles.note: Applies if international garment brands continue automation investment in Bangladesh factories.

scenario_toggles.label: Current infrastructure and investment levels
scenario_toggles.note: Based on current ITU 2024 data for Bangladesh.

scenario_toggles.label: Rural and agricultural context
scenario_toggles.note: Applies for users outside Dhaka, Chittagong in agricultural or rural service work.

source_label: Frey and Osborne (2013), calibrated for Bangladesh using ITU 2024 and sector investment data
